TextLink — Soft underline

Accent text over a soft underline in the border colour, which turns accent on hover. Calmer in dense UI than a full accent underline, still underlined at rest. Subtle is muted text with the same soft line, becoming body text with an accent line on hover. Focus adds a tint behind the ring.
